summary: Official Punjab BhuNaksha and Pathankot district sources establish a local/state cadastral-map custodian and a public viewer. The viewer's current JavaScript exposed bounded hierarchy, extent, coordinate lookup, and WMS routes. One anonymous lookup returned a native plot identity and geometry extent, but the payload also carried unsafe owner details and the public map route returned raster imagery rather than a safe vector polygon. No sample GeoJSON is retained; runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Punjabi discovery queries are recorded in city-5349-pathankot.json. They found official Punjab BhuNaksha, Punjab Land Records, Pathankot district, and municipal cadastral-map sources.
requestOutcomes: TLS-verified browser-like GET/POST requests reached the official viewer. The viewer hierarchy resolved Punjab state 03, Pathankot district 21, Pathankot tehsil 093, and a village path 21,093,035,361,27783. getVVVVExtentGeoref returned a bounded extent and gisCode. ScalarDatahandler OP=4 returned a native plot ID and extent at a bounded metre-coordinate query. The response included owner/property fields, which were not saved. WMS returned raster imagery; no usable vector polygon endpoint or declared CRS was verified.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [32.2691414247988, 75.6476055120517] was preserved; it was not shifted to force a parcel hit.
The bounded coordinate test used a selected Pathankot village hierarchy and is not a citywide coverage test.
No retained GeoJSON sample: the public response was owner-bearing JSON plus an extent, while WMS was raster-only.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, share, or other personal/property fields were retained.
The official municipal draft cadastral PDF is cartographic context only and carries an information-only disclaimer.
A viewer, raster response, absent vector endpoint, exact-point miss, map extent miss, timeout, or login wall is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
Packet completion is research evidence only and does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter; serial review remains required.
